worldcombat.skill.batonpass.summary: Pass actual stages and buffs to the selected live ally. With no entity selected, use a legal reserve. Withdraw or recall only after a real handoff.
worldcombat.skill.batonpass.use.0: Hand the whole stack of stat changes to a teammate
worldcombat.skill.batonpass.use.1: Pass your growth on before it can be stripped away
worldcombat.skill.batonpass.use.2: Pass the baton and disengage when badly hurt
Pass up to %1$s levels: Attack, Defence, Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and Speed changes in descending absolute size, including negative stages. Remaining capacity transfers native buffs. Transferred contributions leave the giver and keep their remaining duration; the handoff icon lasts %2$s.
Hand-off range %1$s blocks; after the pass you step %2$s blocks away from the ally.
worldcombat.skill.batonpass.relay.on: Relay style: carry cap ×1.0, step ×0.6, longer cooldown — give the whole baton to your ally.
worldcombat.skill.batonpass.relay.off: Solo style: carry cap ×0.65, step ×1.2, shorter cooldown — keep part for yourself and pull farther away.
worldcombat.skill.batonpass.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, cost %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.batonpass.growth.0: From level %1$s the baton carries %2$s levels.
worldcombat.skill.batonpass.growth.1: From level %1$s, passes up to %2$s levels over %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.batonpass.preference.r: On: full carry cap, step ×0.6, cooldown +10 — hand over the whole baton. Off (solo): carry cap ×0.65, step ×1.2, cooldown −6 — keep some levels and pull farther away.
worldcombat.skill.batonpass.preference.a: Only hands off when a teammate is this close; lower it to pass only at point-blank, raise it to walk over to them.
When on, the user leaves its post under a hold order to hand the baton to a teammate.
world_combat.move.batonpass.text.preview: Planned stages: Atk%1$s Def%2$s SpA%3$s SpD%4$s Spe%5$s
worldcombat.skill.batonpass.world: Ordinary creatures and players can receive the baton. Each native buff transfers whole, with level I costing one level. It stays with the user if the remaining allowance is too small or the recipient already has a stronger instance.
